notes:
Inbound demo request from early-stage devtool startup. Product: in-editor AI pair-programmer for JS/TS with large-session context (20–60k tokens). Typical user flow: open editor, request multi-file refactor + cross-file search -> needs long context + streaming incremental completions.

"Notes from discovery call (2025-01-20):"
- CTO (A. Lin) says: "we need reliable long-context window and predictable per-minute costs". Very cost-sensitive; willing to accept smaller model for non-critical suggestions.
- Wants token-level billing breakdown visible in console.
- Primary ask: examples of SDK usage (JS/TS) showing streaming + incremental context patching.
- Concerned about soft rate limits during peak (>120 reqs/min) — asked about burst options and autoscaling for Hosted API.
- Security: company uses GSuite SSO, expects SAML/SCIM for team provisioning; audit logs required for enterprise customers.
- Data residency not required at this stage; public cloud ok.

"Key technical constraints / requirements:"
- Average request payload: 6–12k tokens; occasional 40–60k session windows. Need KV cache / prefix-caching support or guidance.
- Latency target: interactive sub-500ms for single-file completions, OK to be 1.5–3s for multi-file refactors.
- Throughput: pilot ~50 concurrent users, ~200–400 requests/min; expected growth 3x in 6 months.
- Cost sensitivity: target <$0.01 per effective completion on common flows.
- Model prefs: open models first (e.g., Llama variants), fall back to smaller higher-accuracy models for critical completions.

- 2025-01-12: inbound signup via docs site; trial account created (free credits).
- 2025-01-15: automated welcome email + quickstart link (owner: Priya).
- 2025-01-20: discovery call (Priya, Diego) — product fit + pricing discussion. Fireflies: ff_20250120_8342.
- 2025-01-22: shared SDK snippets + sample streaming demo repo (drive link).
- 2025-01-29: engineering ping asking for large-context guidance; opened INFER-1023.
- 2025-02-04: follow-up sync scheduled; requested SE deep-dive on batching + rate-limits.

"Notes / shorthand from AE: "
- Good PLG lead; heavy on engineering questions.
- Wants smooth self-serve experience but may convert to paid once usage steady.
- Primary friction: needs concrete SDK examples and clear doc on burst limits and pricing at 50–500 rps.

"Next steps / proposed plan:"
- SE Diego to run 60-min technical demo (Feb 07) covering: streaming SDK (JS/TS), session window techniques, prefix/KV cache patterns, cost/perf tradeoffs.
- Provide annotated example repo with multi-file context stitching + unit tests.
- Share short pricing scenarios for 3 traffic tiers (pilot, scale-1, scale-2) with estimated token costs.
- Follow-up: convert pilot to paid by end of Mar if latency and cost targets met.

- Interest in Optimize features (batching suggestions) if cost per completion remains high.
